input.document_text: Synthetic denial notice. Insurance: Example Health. Service date: 2026-04-10. Denial date: 2026-04-20. Case reference: SYN-VS01. Reason for denial: The MRI is denied because it is not medically necessary under the plan policy. The notice says a written appeal may be filed within 180 days.

Synthetic urgent pre-service adverse benefit notice. Insurance: Example Health. A scheduled infusion is denied before service because medical necessity has not been established. Treating clinician states delay could seriously jeopardize health and requests expedited review. No exact payer deadline is stated.

Synthetic ERISA self-funded employer plan denial. The SPD controls appeal rights. Service date: 2026-04-11. Denial date: 2026-04-22. The lumbar procedure is denied as not medically necessary. The notice references plan medical policy criteria but does not attach the full policy.

Synthetic Original Medicare Summary Notice excerpt. Medicare Fee-for-Service Part B initial determination denied an outpatient service. Service date: 2026-03-12. Denial date: 2026-03-28. The notice references redetermination rights and says minor errors or omissions may be corrected when supported.

Synthetic Medicare Advantage organization determination. Medicare Advantage Part C plan denied pre-service authorization for a scheduled imaging study. The notice states reconsideration rights and that expedited handling may be requested when supported by the treating clinician.

Synthetic Medicaid managed care notice. The plan intends to reduce previously authorized home health hours next month. The notice references appeal rights, state fair hearing rights, and continuation of benefits if the request is timely.

Synthetic commercial denial notice. Insurance: Example Health. Out of network facility charges were denied because the payer says an in-network option was available. The notice does not include network adequacy facts, surprise billing status, or external review eligibility.

Synthetic EOB. Payer: Example Health. Denial code: CO-4. Reason for denial: Procedure code is inconsistent with the modifier. The payer states a corrected claim can be submitted within 30 days. Formal appeal rights are not waived by a correction attempt.

Synthetic commercial denial notice. Insurance: Example Health. Reason for denial: missing documentation. The provider may appeal only with a signed AOB or authorized representative form. No patient authorization is on file. The notice does not prove a direct provider appeal right.

Synthetic appeal response. Example Health upheld the prior denial as a final adverse determination. The response says external review rights may be available after this upheld appeal. The rationale references medical necessity but does not include the complete claim file or reviewed clinical criteria.
